visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a hand holding a tiny miniature plate of curry rice next to a real steaming bowl of curry, broccoli, and rice on a wooden table. (2) A woman with black-framed glasses and a red plaid shirt is seen eating the curry with a wooden spoon in a bright, modern indoor setting. She smiles and nods after tasting. (3) Hands are shown on a light yellow cutting board chopping onions into fine pieces and cutting tomatoes into chunks and halves. The lighting is bright and even. (4) Raw chicken pieces are placed in a metal bowl and seasoned with various spices, including a bright yellow powder and a white paste, then mixed by hand wearing a clear glove. (5) White rice is washed in a strainer and placed into a black pot with water and a small piece of kelp. (6) Olive oil is poured into a large grey pot, followed by layers of chopped onions, tomatoes, sweet potatoes, carrots, and the marinated chicken. (7) The pot is covered with a lid, and the woman is seen adjusting an induction cooktop. Later, the lid is opened to reveal a rich, bubbling curry which is then stirred with a wooden spatula. (8) The final dish of thick, orange-red curry with chunks of meat and vegetables is shown bubbling and being served.
